snippet.title: Burn With Me - Official Release Window Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Release Window Trailer for Burn With Me, a narrative-driven deckbuilding card game developed by Nozomu Games. Players must excel at lining up position-based synergies to summon a Personal Demon, achieve victory, and burn their soul in the process. Burn With Me is launching in Q3 2026 for PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
